title: The Ultimate Bush Plane? | Maule MX-7-180 & H125 Premium Updates [MSFS 2024]
description:
Ready to swap the paved runways for the wild backcountry? In today's Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace update, we're putting the spotlight on the Maule MX-7-180 from Heaven Designs and Giba, a legendary STOL aircraft built for the rough stuff.

Whether you're landing on rocky terrain to camp out or flying cargo, the Maule brings incredible utility with a detailed EFB, interactive covers/chocks, and even a furry companion in the back seat!

We also take a look at the new H125 French Livery Pack by HRSimyard. If you're tired of generic colors, these professional-standard textures (including Gendarmerie and Marine Nationale) bring a whole new level of realism to your helicopter operations in France.

In this video:

- Maule MX-7-180: Interior/Exterior walkthrough, EFB features, and bush flying capabilities.
- H125 French Pack: A look at all 5 premium liveries for the Asobo H125.
- Marketplace Tip: How to rent the Maule before you commit to a purchase.

Which one is going in your hangar first? Are you heading to the mountains or patrolling the coast? Let me know in the comments!
